options.description: A second cheap Haiku call plays the owner: it answers each question from the task's hidden brief, in the owner's role, and never sees the code. This exercises plumb's question path for real and costs one small call per question.
options.label: A scripted owner model (Recommended)

options.description: Every question is answered with its recommended option automatically; a question without one counts as an issue. Cheapest, but the question path is only half exercised.
options.label: No owner: take the recommended option

options.description: The run ends when the first question reaches the owner and scores what was done until then. Measures only how far the model gets without you.
options.label: Stop at the first question

payload.question: During a run, plumb will ask the model questions through the question tool, and the headless model has no owner to answer them. Who answers?
